description: This file contains Perl scripts implementing GHASH functions optimized for ARMv8-A architecture using NEON SIMD instructions. It includes functions for initialization, multiplication, and hashing, with detailed comments on ARM architecture specifics and SIMD register handling.

methods.name: clmul64x64
methods.description: Performs 64x64 polynomial multiplication emulation using ARM NEON instructions, used internally for GHASH calculations.
